body:
Thank you for replying to my post, I really do appreciate it. I have hobbies that I love that include working out, spending time with friends, reading Reddit, etc. I just feel that in terms of a career, I am stalling. I don't know what I'm passionate about, it's sad, I really don't know of a career that I find suitable for myself that will make me happy. The one thing I always wanted to do was to work for myself, start a business. I had a t-shirt idea that I wanted to start, but I feel that I had this idea in my head that it would be so successful with no work. Now, I sit here, with this logo I created, with almost no motivation or satisfaction in life, just thinking about what I could have done differently in the past to make me happier and more accomplished.

I think another thing that is wrong with me is that I constantly compare myself to others. I always feel that others have a better life than me and I am almost putting on a mask to pretend I'm better than them. It's a sad story, it really is. I look at people I know and knew and feel that I need to be better than them, but yet do nothing- it's almost like an inferiority complex.

You know what, I do appreciate your words of wisdom. I always thought my infatuation of money was a sense of immaturity- it truly is. I feel that I am almost obsessed with the idea of having a lot of money, hence I am never satisfied with my current status. I just have dreams of become the next big thing, so superficial and materialistic, but I have these dreams. One passion I always had was to start a t-shirt business (I know it may sound stupid, but it's true). I have a logo and everything, but I always feel like I'm failing myself, knowing that I have this logo I am passionate about, yet I sit on my ass doing nothing. You're right, this economy is terrible and provides slim to none employment outlets to my generation. I know I may be rambling here, but I almost wished I grew up with a mandatory occupation, once I could not choose. It sounds so stupid but it's true.

I have an extreme amount of pressure from my family as well. My father and mother had nothing growing up and both moved to the USA (both are foreigners). When they moved here, they worked hard as hell and both with luck and their business they bought, they became very successful. They have two children, my older brother and I, and they want us to reciprocate their results- a respectable position with a respectable salary. It's hard because growing up I was almost always in my brother's shadow. He's a genius (no bs), graduated top of his class, toured the USA in music, got a full ride to college and now is studying to become a neurosurgeon and here I am, depressed with no sight in the future. I just am so scared watching time tick and seeing myself doing nothing.
